rawAnswer: {"findings":[{"kind":"defect","severity":"medium","title":"Field with null string key still crashes the analyzer","detail":"In the field loop, a keyed member whose key is neither int nor string (for example [Key(null)], which binds to KeyAttribute(string)) reports BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull.
